decisions.credential_revocation_scope: Revoke and rotate the shared CI token pool credential across all six production repositories where it remains valid

commitments.detail: Immediately revoke and rotate the shared CI token pool credential across all six production repositories. Confirm each repository is updated and the old credential is invalidated.

Issue formal notice to the affected enterprise customer within the 24-hour contractual window from the time of exposure. Coordinate with the account team to confirm customer contact and deliver notice before the deadline.
Open an evidence task to store all investigation artifacts in immutable evidence storage for 365 days and obtain compliance sign-off before the response plan is fully closed.

After containment actions are complete, conduct a post-incident review to identify how the credential entered the build log and implement preventive controls (e.g., secret scanning in CI pipelines) to prevent recurrence.
